tools.name: read_lock_race_candidate_context
tools.description: Read a bounded page of hash-bound candidate facts/evidence from the host archive; no arbitrary file or shell access.

tools.name: supplement_lock_race_reviewer_source
tools.description: Host-controlled bounded head-source supplementation; refreshes request provenance, preserves fact gaps, and requires reloading the request. At most four supplements per candidate.

tools.name: create_lock_race_run
tools.description: Create a resumable run; verification scopes are required by default. Unscoped compatibility must be explicitly enabled.

tools.name: get_lock_race_run
tools.description: Read the persisted workflow state and its next_action without advancing it.

tools.name: read_lock_race_reviewer_source
tools.description: Read at most 120 lines of candidate-related source from the pinned PR head while awaiting one reviewer; never reads an arbitrary repository path.

tools.name: submit_lock_race_reviewer_result
tools.description: Validate and persist one bounded read-only reviewer JSON result.

tools.name: submit_lock_race_patch_worker_result
tools.description: Validate one patch-worker report; edited reports proceed to Git capture, refusals are persisted and routed as failed.

tools.name: advance_lock_race_run
tools.description: Run exactly one advertised deterministic step, such as Git capture, verification, revision preparation, or finalization.

tools.name: advance_lock_race_run_until_boundary
tools.description: Run deterministic steps until the next host-owned agent invocation or terminal state; never creates or invokes a subagent.
